hook.on_screen: Presenter gestures as green badge displaying ₹1,400 CRORE appears over red background.
hook.heard: 1400 crore rupees were wrongfully taken from public electricity bills.

tag_meaning: every figure is model-observed on frames sampled from the YouTube link; timestamps and durations are approximate

script.about: Jaipur court ruled that Adani wrongfully extracted 1,400 crore rupees from Rajasthan's power utility for transport costs it was contracted to bear.

beats.said: 1400 crore rupees taken from public electricity bills to benefit Adani.
beats.shows: Presenter introducing the ₹1,400 Crore figure on red background

beats.said: Electricity bills were inflated to channel money into Adani's pockets.
beats.shows: Split screen of presenter and electricity meter with falling banknotes

beats.said: A Jaipur court ruled that an Adani company gained this wrongfully.
beats.shows: Outlook article headline with words highlighted in black

beats.said: Mainstream media ignored this court judgment favoring Adani.
beats.shows: Presenter top, photo of Gautam Adani wearing crown with money fan bottom

beats.said: Rajasthan state power company RRVUNL paid Adani wrongfully.
beats.shows: Scroll article headline top and RRVUNL emblem seal bottom

beats.said: RRVUNL admitted in court that Adani arm-twisted them to avoid shortages.
beats.shows: Scroll article screenshot highlighted, presenter in circle at bottom

beats.said: State companies are now intimidated by private corporations.
beats.shows: Presenter speaking to camera on red background

beats.said: RRVUNL accused Adani of constant extortion and wrongful gain.
beats.shows: Split view with presenter top and Scroll article quote bottom

beats.said: In 2007, RRVUNL and Adani formed a joint venture.
beats.shows: RRVUNL and Adani logos with 2007 badge between them

beats.said: The joint venture was named Parsa Kente Colliery Limited.
beats.shows: Team photo with Parsa Kente Colliery Ltd sign

beats.said: Adani owned 74 percent while the government held only 26 percent.
beats.shows: Bar chart comparing Adani Enterprises 74% and RRVUNL 26%

beats.said: PKCL was tasked to mine and transport Chhattisgarh coal to Rajasthan.
beats.shows: Presenter top, aerial b-roll of coal open-cast mine bottom

beats.said: Contract obligated PKCL to build a railway line to transport coal.
beats.shows: Scroll article text on railway siding contract clause, presenter in circle

beats.said: PKCL failed to build the line, forcing expensive road transport.
beats.shows: Presenter explaining road transport failure on red background

beats.said: A third party was hired, but PKCL was contracted to pay.
beats.shows: Dump truck in quarry with PKCL label below

beats.said: Instead, RRVUNL footed the entire 1,400 crore rupee road transportation bill.
beats.shows: Falling cash graphic with RRVUNL label and 1400 crore stamp

beats.said: Surprisingly, Adani dragged the government to court, not vice versa.
beats.shows: Presenter speaking to camera expressing disbelief

beats.said: Adani demanded interest on delayed transport reimbursements from RRVUNL.
beats.shows: Scroll excerpt detailing interest demand on bank loans

beats.said: RRVUNL quietly paid 1400 crore but got sued for payment delay.
beats.shows: Presenter full screen with RRVUNL emblem on chest

beats.said: Adani demanded an extra 65 crore rupees in interest.
beats.shows: Scroll article text highlighting 65 crore interest claim

beats.said: The court examined the contract and found PKCL responsible for transport.
beats.shows: Presenter detailing court findings

beats.said: Court fined PKCL 50 lakh, ordered CAG audit, but High Court stayed.
beats.shows: Outlook article text with highlight on 50 lakh fine and stay order

beats.said: Public bears the loss while private companies reap all profits.
beats.shows: Village houses top, photo of Gautam Adani shaking hands with PM Modi bottom

beats.said: Meanwhile, another severe environmental impact is underway.
beats.shows: Presenter introducing the environmental report

beats.said: Clearance granted to chop 4.5 lakh trees in Hasdeo forest.
beats.shows: The Hindu article with yellow highlight on 4.5 lakh trees felling

beats.said: Deforestation approved solely to start another coal mining project.
beats.shows: Presenter concluding urgently to camera
